Definition: a Sepharvite or inhabitant of Sepharvain
BiblicalUsage: A Sepharvite is an inhabitant of Sepharvaim, and the one place the word appears is a dark one — the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to their gods after being settled in Samaria.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this single hard verse is there to show how far a people can fall when they carry their idols into a new land.
